title: SUMI — INK AND STEEL
logline: A blue-robed samurai fights a time-piercing syndicate from feudal Japan to cyberpunk 2090, then back to the first wound in time.

intro_cards.title: Masayoshi 正義
intro_cards.text: Blue robes. Long ponytail. A vow cut into smoke.

intro_cards.title: The Black Pagoda
intro_cards.text: Yakuza, ninja, and fallen samurai steal weapons from impossible tomorrows.

intro_cards.title: Ink and Steel
intro_cards.text: Move through painted depth. Fight, inspect, converse, and survive.

intro_cards.title: The Future Wound
intro_cards.text: Midway through the hunt, a portal opens and cyber samurai call the villains home.

chapter1_dojo.interlude: Master Hideo is gone. The first raiders fall, but their blades carry metal no forge in Edo has seen. Masayoshi follows smoke toward the market.
chapter1_dojo.level_design: Room-box adventure-brawler: Teach room exits, keys, lane-depth movement, and first level-exit door.

chapter2_market.interlude: The lantern market whispers of a mountain shrine. Civilians speak in fragments: black masks, stolen thunder, and a gate that opens during eclipse.
chapter2_market.level_design: Room-box adventure-brawler: Teach crowds, shortcuts, canal flanks, and civilian clues.

chapter3_mountain_pass.interlude: At the shrine, monks confess the syndicate buys prayers with rifles and future coin. The path now points to an eclipse courtyard.
chapter3_mountain_pass.level_design: Room-box adventure-brawler: Teach vertical routes, rope bridges, ranged threats, and shrine switches.

chapter4_eclipse_portal.interlude: Just as Masayoshi reaches the boss, a violet future wound opens. Cyber samurai step through and call the Black Pagoda home. Masayoshi jumps after them.
chapter4_eclipse_portal.level_design: Room-box adventure-brawler: Teach portal instability, feudal/cyber overlap, and midpoint boss exit.

chapter5_neon_arrival.interlude: The future is not saved. It is occupied. Masayoshi learns he must install enemy tech or die before reaching the time engine.
chapter5_neon_arrival.level_design: Room-box adventure-brawler: Teach future hazards, cyber NPCs, neon paths, and chrome upgrade rooms.

chapter6_chrome_slums.interlude: Every enhancement makes him stronger and less certain. The slums point upward: the syndicate descendants rule from the skyway.
chapter6_chrome_slums.level_design: Room-box adventure-brawler: Teach tower ascent, security locks, server switches, and risk/reward branches.

chapter7_skyway_siege.interlude: The skyway burns. Masayoshi finds the coordinates of the first tear and the price of undoing it.
chapter7_skyway_siege.level_design: Room-box adventure-brawler: Teach speed, exposed routes, drone pressure, and high/low road choices.

chapter8_time_engine.interlude: The time engine falls silent. Humanity remains scarred, but the path back is open. Masayoshi returns to stop the wound before it begins.
chapter8_time_engine.level_design: Room-box adventure-brawler: Final exam: all route, key, switch, boss, and explicit final-exit lessons.

ending.title: THE FIRST WOUND SEALED
ending.text: Masayoshi returns before the first tear. He carries chrome scars under indigo robes, choosing humanity not because he remained pure, but because he kept choosing it.
